title: Innsbrucker Dom St. Jakob
highlights: Bedeutendes Meisterwerk des Hochbarock im Herzen der Innsbrucker Altstadt
Weltberühmtes Gnadenbild Maria Hilf von Lucas Cranach dem Älteren
Monumentales Grabmal von Erzherzog Maximilian III. mit Bronzefiguren
Prachtvolle Deckenfresken und Stuckarbeiten der Gebrüder Asam
kurzbeschreibung: The Innsbrucker Dom St. Jakob is a magnificent Baroque cathedral featuring the famous miraculous image of Maria Hilf by Lucas Cranach.
beschreibung:
Baroque Splendor in the Heart of Innsbruck

The Innsbrucker Dom St. Jakob rises gracefully near the Kaiserliche Hofburg and forms the spiritual center of the Tyrolean provincial capital. Rebuilt in the early 18th century by master builder Johann Jakob Herkomer following an earthquake, the cathedral captivates with harmonious spatial proportions and ornate Baroque furnishings.

Cultural Treasure and Pilgrimage Site

The high altar houses the world-famous devotional painting Maria Hilf by Lucas Cranach the Elder, attracting countless believers and art lovers alike. The masterly dome frescoes by the brothers Cosmas Damian and Egid Quirin Asam, together with the monumental tomb of Maximilian III, make the cathedral an essential cultural highlight.
